topic: Everyone was able to leave before the storm
title: Everyone was able to leave before the storm
pt: Foco da aula: was / were able to vs could: capacidade no passado

solo90.name: Pausa

group90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Ben, thank goodness you are here! Everyone was able to leave before the storm hit, but our flight was delayed twice.
lines.pt: Ben, ainda bem que você está aqui! Todos conseguiram sair antes de a tempestade chegar, mas nosso voo atrasou duas vezes.

lines.en: I know, Alma. I could not call you, because my battery died, and the airport internet was down for an hour.
lines.pt: Eu sei, Alma. Não consegui ligar para você, porque a bateria acabou e a internet do aeroporto ficou fora do ar por uma hora.

lines.en: Luckily the staff were very organised. They were able to move all the passengers to the north terminal in forty minutes.
lines.pt: Felizmente a equipe estava muito organizada. Conseguiram levar todos os passageiros ao terminal norte em quarenta minutos.

lines.en: Impressive. When I was a student, I could sleep anywhere, but last night I was not able to close my eyes.
lines.pt: Impressionante. Quando eu era estudante, dormia em qualquer lugar, mas ontem à noite não consegui fechar os olhos.

lines.en: Same here. A mother with two small children was able to board first, and the boy could read the whole menu aloud.
lines.pt: Comigo também. Uma mãe com dois filhos pequenos conseguiu embarcar primeiro, e o menino conseguia ler o cardápio inteiro em voz alta.

lines.en: Did they manage to find seats together? Yesterday a family was not able to sit next to each other on my flight.
lines.pt: Eles conseguiram lugares juntos? Ontem uma família não conseguiu sentar um ao lado do outro no meu voo.

lines.en: Yes, a flight attendant was able to change the seats. She is the reason so many people could relax in the end.
lines.pt: Sim, uma comissária conseguiu trocar os lugares. Ela é o motivo de tanta gente ter conseguido relaxar no fim.

lines.en: Good for her. By the way, were you able to rebook the hotel? The storm closed half of the roads downtown.
lines.pt: Bom para ela. Aliás, você conseguiu remarcar o hotel? A tempestade fechou metade das ruas do centro.

lines.en: I was, but only after waiting forty minutes on the phone. I could not believe how patient the agent was.
lines.pt: Consegui, mas só depois de esperar quarenta minutos no telefone. Não acreditei em como o atendente foi paciente.

lines.en: Then we are lucky. I read that the airport could not open the runway until morning, so most flights are cancelled.
lines.pt: Então temos sorte. Li que o aeroporto não pôde abrir a pista até de manhã, então a maioria dos voos foi cancelada.

lines.en: Right. Our plane leaves in ten minutes, so let us hurry to the gate before they close it.
lines.pt: Certo. Nosso avião sai em dez minutos, então vamos correr para o portão antes que fechem.

facts.label: Capacidade no passado
facts.sub: was/were able to para fatos; could para capacidade geral.

facts.label: was able to + infinitivo
facts.sub: Use para um resultado específico que deu certo: Everyone was able to leave before the storm. Em português: “conseguiram”. Também serve managed to.

facts.label: could + infinitivo
facts.sub: Use para capacidade geral no passado: He could read at four. Não serve para um resultado único afirmativo; nesse caso use was able to.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Everyone was able to leave describes one specific result.
We can say “Everyone could leave before the storm” for one event.
items.why: Use were able to for a specific success.

items.s: Could describes a general ability in the past.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Everyone was able to leave describes one specific result. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We can say “Everyone could leave before the storm” for one event. → Falso (Use were able to for a specific success.)
Could describes a general ability in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Everyone was able to leave · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a stormy night in Atlanta. Alma waits at the airport. Rain hits the big windows. A voice calls a late flight. Ben runs in. They meet near the gate.

“Ben, thank goodness you are here! Everyone was able to leave before the storm hit, but our flight was delayed twice.” says Alma. “I know, Alma. I could not call you, because my battery died, and the airport internet was down for an hour.” says Ben. “Luckily the staff were very organised. They were able to move all the passengers to the north terminal in forty minutes.” says Alma.
